_what_this_is: the readings behind choosing a work model, taken on the kernel's own prompt assembly against real llama-server processes. Nothing in this repository re-derives them: no inference here, no model, no download
_why_this_file_exists: the work half of the kernel had never been held to the rule src/README.md line 25 already applies to the watch half — a model chosen by measurement rather than by size. The measurement that produced this file was made on issue #89 and exists nowhere else

rig.server: llama-server version 0.7.0-dev (build 1, commit 701fd25), built with AppleClang 17.0.0 for Darwin arm64
rig.flags: -m <model.gguf> --alias <name> --host 127.0.0.1 --port <port> -c 4096 -np 1 -ngl 99, plus --mmproj <projector.gguf> for the model that has one
rig.jinja: enabled by default in this build (--help reports '--jinja, --no-jinja ... (default: enabled)'), so the GGUF's own chat template renders the tool list into the system message. Verified on the shipped model's template: it appends 'List of tools: [...]' to the system prompt. No row here was measured with tools withheld from the model
rig.request: the kernel's own assembly, not a paraphrase: assembleWorkPrompt(loadWorkArtifact(), values) from src/prompts.ts, the artifact's system part sent as role system, the rest as role user, and the artifact's tools sent as-is
rig.what_counts: delivered = a say() call whose room is the assembled room and whose text is non-empty; prose = no call at all and non-empty content; silent = no call and empty content. Each row carries the case it was measured on in `text` and the model's own words in `reply`
rig.host: the owner's laptop, macOS arm64, Metal offload (-ngl 99), CPU idle

prompt.ask: Say something now if it is worth saying: call say with the room {room} and the words you want in it. If nothing here is worth answering, write nothing at all — a turn that says nothing is a finished turn, not a failed one.
prompt.note: not one character of the artifact was changed for any row. Rewording it was tried on 2026-10-26 and moved nothing (issue #89), so what the rows differ in is the model alone

cases: calibration/work/cases.json — nine cases, six that should end with a call and three that should end in silence

what_was_not_measured: stage 1 on these nine cases. In production a work turn exists only after the judgement said act, so how many of the three quiet cases ever reach a work model is unmeasured here; the gate's own behaviour on them is a separate reading and this file does not supply it
images. Every case is text. The two Qwen candidates are multimodal and ship a projector, but no picture was put in front of them, so nothing here says they see
a box holding more than one message: every case is one entry, the same limit calibration/provenance.md records for the judgement
temperature above 0, and any sampling: three repeats at temperature 0 changed no outcome (0/9 per model), which is a statement about determinism, not about the distribution

the quiet column's ceiling. No model tested reached silence even once, so whether silence is reachable at all with this ask is open — the shipped model writes prose instead of nothing, which is equally no message and not the same behaviour

files._what: the exact bytes each row was measured on, so a reader can confirm they measured the same file
